body:
For anyone out there who likes to use inhalents, I have the one for you.  Go over to your local Autozone (Yes has to be Autozone!) and pick up a can of 'Carb Cleaner.'  It is in a yellow can with red writting.  While you are there pick up a bundle of 5 of those red shop rags for $1.99. Now, C.C. (Carb Cleaner) is very potent stuff, but if it is used in the right way can give you a most rightous Buz.
Now, you will need either one of those red rags or a sock.  Preferrably I use a good clean soft cotton sock. Fold the medium in half or in three (whatever fits your nose) and spray on some, (Start wiht a small amount) C.C.  You need to casually inhale or breathethrough your nose, NOT HUFF!!!  Contrary to popular belief less amounts of inalents for long periods of time give better results.
For Example if you hit some computer cleaner, you will get a good short buzz.  Now, if you use a milder inhalent like this you can slowly cut off oxygen to your brain instead of quickly doing this and risking death.  If you cut off the O2 to your head for a good thirty of fourty minutes, (I can use C.C. for hours, seriously) you create a wonderful state of Uphoria!  Kind of like being delirious.
